items.html: The matter of the division of these kings into the 32 paths of wisdom is this: the kings are eight, and each one divides into four, in the secret of the four letters of the name HaVaYaH; and eight times four makes thirty-two. And each of these is included of ten, making three hundred and twenty. This is “the venom of the king's wrath” (320), which is in the secret of judgments and wrath.
